description: Uncertain multimodal body belief, event-timed local control, receipt-grounded actuator physiology, adaptive credit, allostatic forecasting and procedural replay for arbitrary bodies, with plant plasticity admitted outside the local control deadline.

rules.name: esm_normalize_humanoid_motor_trial
rules.comment: Normalize a graph-authored domain trial before any simulator receipt exists.

rules.name: esm_normalize_humanoid_primitive_motor_trial
rules.comment: Normalize a graph-authored domain trial before any simulator receipt exists.

rules.name: esm_normalize_ground_motor_trial
rules.comment: Normalize a graph-authored domain trial before any simulator receipt exists.

rules.name: esm_normalize_aerial_motor_trial
rules.comment: Normalize a graph-authored domain trial before any simulator receipt exists.

rules.name: esm_open_uncertain_body_belief
rules.comment: Embodied control owns an uncertain inferred body state; the simulator state is evidence, never the belief itself.

rules.name: esm_project_current_body_belief
rules.comment: After the mechanical boundary publishes a new delayed sample, restore the predictive body belief onto the legacy state interface before body-specific action rules read it.

rules.name: esm_open_opaque_actuator_envelope
rules.comment: The biological plant abstraction is causal rather than anatomical: latency, compliance, efficiency, stability, fatigue and thermal load apply to limbs, wheels, rotors, jets and control surfaces.

rules.name: esm_open_embodied_controller_value
rules.comment: Install the adaptive core's value contract before a dynamically materialized motor decision reaches that core.

rules.name: esm_bridge_motor_trial_to_adaptive_decision
rules.comment: Reuse the core efference-copy and eligibility machinery for every graph-authored embodied intervention.

rules.name: esm_integrate_delayed_multimodal_receipt
rules.comment: Precision-weighted prediction and correction fuses proprioceptive, vestibular and contact evidence. The resulting belief is written back to the episode interface consumed by existing motor rules, replacing privileged state with inferred state.

rules.name: esm_learn_actuator_plant_envelope
rules.comment: Verified receipts recruit this interruptible plant plasticity through the shared adaptive-learning task set; actuator release and local viability remain on the hard sheet.

rules.name: esm_request_verified_receipt_learning
rules.comment: A verified physical receipt is the graph-owned permission to run automatic plasticity and model integration outside the local control deadline.

rules.name: esm_advance_adaptive_clock_from_motor_receipt
rules.comment: A verified motor receipt is explicit temporal evidence. Advance the graph-held adaptive clock from its monotone receipt sequence so eligibility and transient lifetimes do not depend on host ticks.

rules.name: esm_archive_expired_eligibility_trace
rules.comment: Once adaptive learning expires a bounded eligibility trace, move only its agent index edge to archival history. The trace, its causal links, and every learned controller value remain intact, while future credit matching stays bounded by the live horizon.

rules.name: esm_archive_fully_credited_adaptive_outcome
rules.comment: After every still-live context-local eligibility trace has received an evaluated outcome, move that outcome off the active credit index. The receipt-owned edge and outcome node preserve the audit trail; only the quadratic historical join is collapsed.

rules.name: esm_publish_sensorimotor_network_mode_sample
rules.comment: Motor uncertainty and predicted internal deficit feed the existing overlapping salience/executive/default network dynamics.

rules.name: esm_request_motor_replay_integration
rules.comment: When the default-mode core reconstructs a procedural episode, the resulting context authors a separate interruptible request to integrate that replay into its forward controller.
